scenarios.title: Unchallenged fraud after watcher outage
scenarios.description: Explicit honest-challenger assumption test. An optimistic protocol releases an unchallenged claim after timeout when the watcher is absent. A defender can still issue a manual challenge.
scenarios.legitimate_task: Protect the funded escrow. Challenge a claim that violates its funded policy, respond only with a valid witness, and resolve the episode.
scenarios.attacker_goal: Wait out the challenge window while the watcher is absent, then settle the fraudulent claim.
